name: sevdesk-mcp

tools.name: sevdesk_ping
tools.description: Verify that the API token works, report the server mode (read-only / dry-run) and the account's bookkeeping system version (1.0 uses taxType, 2.0 uses taxRule). Run this first when something behaves unexpectedly.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_vouchers
tools.description: List incoming/outgoing vouchers with the fields that matter for bookkeeping: date, supplier, gross/net/tax, status and the decoded VAT treatment. Read-only.

supplier.description: Case-insensitive substring of the supplier name.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_voucher
tools.description: Fetch a single voucher including its line items, with the VAT treatment and per-position tax rates decoded. Read-only.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices you issued, with number, customer, sums, status and dates. Read-only.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_contacts
tools.description: List customers and suppliers. Read-only.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of the contact name.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions, optionally for one account and period. Read-only.

checkAccountId.description: Restrict to one bank account id.

tools.name: sevdesk_upload_voucher_file
tools.description: Upload a local PDF/image to sevDesk's temporary voucher storage and return the filename token you pass to sevdesk_create_voucher. WRITE operation — refused under SEVDESK_READ_ONLY. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the receipt file on this machine.

mimeType.description: Override the content type (default guessed from the extension).

dryRun.description: Preview the request without sending it.

tools.name: sevdesk_create_voucher
tools.description: Create a voucher via /Voucher/Factory/saveVoucher. Defaults to status 50 (Entwurf) so nothing is booked without you reviewing it in sevDesk. Set taxRule 5 for Reverse Charge §13b, 1 for normal domestic VAT, 3 for intra-EU. WRITE operation. For anything this wrapper does not cover, use sevdesk_call with operationId 'voucherFactorySaveVoucher'. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

supplierName.description: Supplier name as it should appear on the voucher.

payDate.description: Payment date, dd.mm.yyyy — only with status 1000.

taxRate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 19 or 0.

extra.description: Additional top-level voucher fields merged into the payload verbatim.

dryRun.description: Show the payload instead of sending it.

tools.name: sevdesk_receipt_guidance
tools.description: sevDesk's own booking guidance: which DATEV/SKR accounts exist for expenses or revenue and which tax rules and rates each of them allows — the table sevDesk validates against when a voucher is booked. Filter by text, account number or tax rule; output is capped, never the full account dump. Read-only.

side.description: Which side to fetch guidance for (default expense).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring over account number, name and description.

taxRuleId.description: Only accounts that allow this tax rule id, e.g. '12'.

tools.name: sevdesk_set_tax_rule
tools.description: Rebook a voucher onto a different VAT rule (e.g. from 'Vorsteuerabziehbare Aufwendungen' onto Reverse Charge §13b, taxRule 12) with guardrails: refuses enshrined vouchers and rules from the wrong side of the books, verifies the result afterwards, and previews the request with dryRun. The voucher's positions keep their rates. Only works on draft vouchers — the sevDesk API refuses updates on booked/paid ones, and resetting a paid foreign-currency voucher via the API recalculates its EUR amounts at today's rate. Correct paid vouchers in the sevDesk UI instead. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

dryRun.description: Preview the request without sending it.

tools.name: sevdesk_create_invoice
tools.description: Create an outgoing invoice as a draft (status 50) — always a draft, so nothing reaches a customer without review in sevDesk. Positions carry name, quantity, price and tax rate; the contact's address is filled in automatically. Honors SEVDESK_DRY_RUN. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

contactId.description: Numeric id of the customer contact.

taxRate.description: VAT rate; defaults to 19, or 0 for Kleinunternehmer.

taxRuleId.description: Revenue tax rule id (default 1, or 11 for Kleinunternehmer).

dryRun.description: Preview the request without sending it.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Fetch the rendered PDF of an invoice and save it into a directory from the SEVDESK_RECEIPT_DIRS allowlist. Never changes the invoice's send state (preventSendBy). Read-only towards sevDesk.

directory.description: Absolute path of an allowlisted directory to save the PDF into.

tools.name: sevdesk_mark_invoice_sent
tools.description: Mark an invoice as sent without emailing anything (send types: PDF download, print, postal — deliberately no email). Refuses enshrined invoices and verifies the result. Honors SEVDESK_DRY_RUN. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

sendType.description: How the invoice left the house (default VPDF).

dryRun.description: Preview the request without sending it.

tools.name: sevdesk_audit_vat
tools.description: Sweep vouchers (Belege) and flag VAT problems: foreign suppliers booked as plain domestic expenses (taxRule 9/10) instead of Reverse Charge §13b (taxRule 12/13/14), revenue rules sitting on expense vouchers, tax rates that contradict the chosen rule, sums that do not add up, and the same supplier booked inconsistently across vouchers. Read-only. This is the check that tells you whether your §13b amounts will be reported correctly in the VAT return.

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

includePositions.description: Fetch line items to check rates per position (default true, slower).

tools.name: sevdesk_reverse_charge_report
tools.description: Total the reverse-charge (§13b) tax base for a period, split by meaning: expense vouchers with input-tax deduction (taxRule 12/14, nets to zero), without deduction (taxRule 13, VAT actually payable), and your own §13b revenue (taxRule 5). Separately lists vouchers that look like they belong in the report but are not booked that way. Read-only.

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

rate.description: VAT rate to apply to the base (default 19).

tools.name: sevdesk_find_duplicates
tools.description: Detect vouchers booked twice (same document number, or same supplier + amount within a few days) and vouchers left in Entwurf/offen status. Read-only.

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

dayWindow.description: How many days apart two same-amount vouchers may be to count as duplicates (default 7).

tools.name: sevdesk_subscription_gaps
tools.description: Detect suppliers that bill on a monthly cadence and report months with no voucher. A subscription that appears in March, April and June but not May almost always means a receipt was never entered. Read-only.

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

minMonths.description: How many distinct months a supplier needs before it counts as recurring (default 3).

tools.name: sevdesk_diff_receipt_folder
tools.description: Compare a local folder of receipt PDFs against the vouchers booked in sevDesk and report both directions: files that appear to have no voucher, and vouchers with no matching file. Matching uses the #reference in the filename first, then date + amount. Filenames are expected to look like '260626_Acme-Cloud_#INV-2043.pdf' or '2026-06-26_AcmeCloud_45.60.pdf'. Reads the filesystem but never writes; sevDesk access is read-only.

directory.description: Absolute path to the folder holding the receipt files.

from.description: Only consider vouchers from this date on.

to.description: Only consider vouchers up to this date.

dayTolerance.description: Days a file date may differ from the voucher date (default 5).

tools.name: sevdesk_reconcile_transactions
tools.description: Match bank transactions against vouchers by amount and date proximity, in both directions: payments with no plausible voucher (missing receipts) and non-draft vouchers no payment covers. Matching is a heuristic — treat the result as a checklist, not a verdict. Read-only.

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

dayWindow.description: Maximum days between payment and voucher date to still count as a match (default 5).

tools.name: sevdesk_invoice_aging
tools.description: Who owes you money and for how long: open and partially paid invoices bucketed by days overdue (invoice date + payment terms), the outstanding remainder per invoice, drafts that were never sent, and open invoices missing a send mark. Read-only.

from.description: Start of period (invoice date), dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_operations
tools.description: Search the sevDesk API catalogue (151 operations, API 2.0.0). Use this to find the operationId for anything not covered by a dedicated tool, then call sevdesk_describe_operation for its parameters and sevdesk_call to execute it. Available tags: AccountingContact, Basics, CheckAccount, CheckAccountTransaction, CommunicationWay, Contact, ContactAddress, ContactField, CreditNote, CreditNotePos, Export, Invoice, InvoicePos, Layout, Order, OrderPos, Part, Report, Tag, Voucher, VoucherPos.

query.description: Free-text search over operationId, path, tags and summary, e.g. 'voucher pdf'.

tag.description: Restrict to one resource tag, e.g. 'Voucher' or 'Invoice'.

kind.description: Filter by effect: read (GET), write (POST/PUT/DELETE), or all.

tools.name: sevdesk_describe_operation
tools.description: Show the full parameter list, request-body shape and an example call for one operationId. Always do this before sevdesk_call on an operation you have not used before.

operationId.description: Exact operationId, as returned by sevdesk_list_operations.

tools.name: sevdesk_call
tools.description: Execute any operation from the catalogue. Path parameters are taken from `params` by name; remaining `params` entries become query parameters. Nested objects are encoded in sevDesk's bracket syntax (a[b]=c). Mutating operations are refused when the server runs with SEVDESK_READ_ONLY=true, and are only described (not sent) when SEVDESK_DRY_RUN=true or `dryRun` is passed. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

params.description: Path and query parameters, keyed by parameter name.

body.description: JSON request body, for POST/PUT operations.

dryRun.description: Describe the request that would be sent instead of sending it.
